topic: Applying for a First Social Security Number at the Office

script.title: THE LITTLE CARD
script.scene_zh: 社安署櫃檯 · 申請社保卡
script.story_hook: A first job needs one small paper card.
script.intro_zh: 第一份工作，就差這一張小小的卡。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today we visit the SSA office. Listen for name and document words.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天我們到社安署櫃檯辦卡。留意姓名與文件相關的說法。
script.outro: And that's one card on its way. Listen again and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 一張社保卡就這樣上路了。再聽一遍，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a tall young man in his mid twenties with a closely faded black haircut, silver rectangular glasses, a rust orange crewneck sweater under a charcoal blazer, and a slim lanky build
script.char_b_description: a solidly built woman in her fifties with a chin-length dark brown bob, cat-eye glasses, a cream blouse under a forest green cardigan, and a name tag pinned straight

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning. I have an appointment to apply today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔɹnɪŋ aɪ hæv æn əˈpɑɪntmənt tə əˈplaɪ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 上午好。我預約了今天來申請。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, we love walk-ins... I'm kidding, sit down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt wi lʌv ˈwɑkˌɪnz aɪm ˈkɪdɪŋ sɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我們最愛現場來的人……開玩笑的，請坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha. First time here, so my face may look lost.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɝst taɪm hɪɹ soʊ maɪ feɪs meɪ lʊk lɑst/
dialogue.zh: 哈。我第一次來，所以表情可能一副迷路樣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is! So, a Social Security card for work?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz soʊ ə ˈsoʊʃəl ˈsɛkjəɹi kɑɹd fɚ wɝk/
dialogue.zh: 這棟樓確實大。所以是為了工作申請社保卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, my job starts Monday, and they need it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs maɪ dʒɑb stɑɹtz ˈmʌnˌdeɪ ænd ðeɹ nid ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，我週一要上班，他們需要這張卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you're in the right line. Passport?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jʊɹ ɪn ðə ɹaɪt laɪn ˈpæspɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 那你排對隊了。護照呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Passport, visa papers, all in this blue folder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpæspɔɹt ˈvizə ˈpeɪpɚz ɔl ɪn ðɪs blu ˈfoʊldɚ/
dialogue.zh: 護照、簽證文件，全在這個藍色資料夾裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great folder. We need three proofs: age, identity, status.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ˈfoʊldɚ wi nid θɹi prufs eɪdʒ aɪˈdɛntəti ˈsteɪtəs/
dialogue.zh: 資料夾準備得好。我們要三項證明：年齡、身份、合法停留。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Status meaning... my permission to work, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsteɪtəs ˈminɪŋ maɪ pɚˈmɪʃən tə wɝk ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 合法停留⋯⋯是指我的工作許可，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, your visa and work permit cover that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli jɔɹ ˈvizə ænd wɝk pɚˈmɪt ˈkʌvɚ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 完全正確，簽證和工作許可就把這兩項蓋住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew, I brought copies too, just in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /fju aɪ bɹɑt ˈkɑpiz tu dʒʌst ɪn keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 呼，我連影本都帶來了，以防萬一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart move, though originals stay here briefly.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt muv ðoʊ əˈɹɪdʒənəls steɪ hɪɹ ˈbɹifli/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。不過原件要在我們這兒留一下下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Briefly is fine, my lunch break covers it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɹifli ɪz faɪn maɪ lʌntʃ breɪk ˈkʌvɚz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一下下沒問題，我的午休時間撐得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful. Now this form asks your full legal name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl naʊ ðɪs fɔɹm æsks jɔɹ fʊl ˈliɡəl neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。這張表格要問你的法定全名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, here's the tricky thing about my name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm hɪɹz ðə ˈtɹɪki θɪŋ əˈbaʊt maɪ ˈneɪm/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我的名字有一點小狀況。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh? Names have stories, take your time.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ˈneɪmz hæv ˈstɔɹiz teɪk jɔɹ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 噢？名字都有故事，你慢慢說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My papers show Kwame Osei, no middle name.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpeɪpɚz ʃoʊ kwaˈmeɪ ˈoʊseɪ noʊ ˈmɪdəl neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我的文件上寫的是 Kwame Osei，沒有中間名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's simple, just leave the middle box blank.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈsɪmpəl dʒʌst liːv ðə ˈmɪdəl bɑks blæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 那很簡單，中間名那一格留空就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But my school form listed one, Kofi.
dialogue.phonetic: /bət maɪ skul fɔɹm ˈlɪstəd wʌn ˈkoʊfi/
dialogue.zh: 可我學校的報名表填了一個，Kofi。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, the card must match your documents.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðə kɑɹd məst mætʃ jɔɹ ˈdɑkjəmənts/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，卡片上的名字一定要和文件一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So which name wins, the school's or the passport?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɪtʃ ˈneɪm wɪnz ðə skulz ɔɹ ðə ˈpæspɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 那哪個名字說得算，學校的還是護照的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The passport, always. Records love one story.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpæspɔɹt ˈɔlˌweɪz ˈɹɛkɚdz lʌv wʌn ˈstɔɹi/
dialogue.zh: 護照，永遠是護照。檔案最愛單一版本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then blank it is, and Kofi can retire.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn blæŋk ɪt ɪz ænd ˈkoʊfi kən ɹɪˈtaɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那就留空，Kofi 可以光榮退休了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kofi can rest, yes. And your birth date?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkoʊfi kən ɹɛst jɛs ænd jɔɹ bɜɹθ deɪt/
dialogue.zh: 讓 Kofi 好好休息。你的出生日期是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: June second, nineteen ninety-nine, on page two.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒun ˈsɛkənd ˌnɪnˈtin ˈnɪntiˌnaɪn ɑn peɪdʒ tu/
dialogue.zh: 六月二日，一九九九年，就寫在第二頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Where were you born, city and country?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt wɛɹ wɜɹ ju bɔɹn ˈsɪti ænd ˈkʌntri/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。你出生的城市和國家呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Accra, Ghana. City or country first, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈkɹɑ ˈɡɑnə ˈsɪti ɔɹ ˈkʌntri fɝst ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 阿克拉，迦納。不過要先寫城市還是國家？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: City, comma, country, exactly like your passport.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪti ˈkɑmə ˈkʌntri ɪɡˈzæktli laɪk jɔɹ ˈpæspɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 城市、逗號、國家，和護照上一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. So, when will the card actually arrive?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn soʊ wɛn wɪl ðə kɑɹd ˈæktʃuəli əˈɹaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 寫好了。那這張卡到底什麼時候會到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two weeks by mail, sometimes closer to one.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wiɪks baɪ meɪl ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ˈkloʊsɚ tə wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 掛號郵件兩週，有時候快一點，一週左右。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only two weeks? My boss keeps asking me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli tu wiɪks maɪ bɑs keeps ˈæskɪŋ mi/
dialogue.zh: 只要兩週？我老闆一直在追問我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him the receipt we give works meanwhile.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɪm ðə rɪˈsit wi ɡiv wɝks ˈmilˌwaɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 告訴他，我們今天給的收據可以先行代勞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I get paper proof today, that helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪ ɡɛt ˈpeɪpɚ pruf təˈdeɪ ðæt hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 噢，今天就能拿到書面證明，那有救。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One page, dated, signed, very official looking.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn peɪdʒ ˈdeɪɾəd saɪnd ˈvɛɹi əˈfɪʃəəl ˈlʊkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 就一張紙，有日期、有簽名，看起來很正式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beautiful. One more worry, um, where do I keep it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbjutəfəl wʌn mɔɹ ˈwɜɹi ʌm wɛɹ du aɪ kip ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我還有一個擔心，嗯，這張卡該放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great question. Never in a wallet, ever.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ˈkwɛstʃən ˈnɛvɚ ɪn ə ˈwɑlət ˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 問得好。千萬別放錢包，永遠都別。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, what? The card is basically my ID.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt wʌt ðə kɑɹd ɪz ˈbæsɪkli maɪ aɪˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 等等，什麼？這張卡基本上就是我的身份證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not really, it lists no photo, no address.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈɹiəli ɪt lɪsts noʊ ˈfoʊˌtoʊ noʊ əˈdɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 其實不算，它上面沒照片、沒地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Huh, I thought it looked safe in plastic.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌ aɪ θɔt ɪt lʊkt seɪf ɪn ˈplæstɪk/
dialogue.zh: 嘖，我還以為它躲在透明塑膠套裡最安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's paper, and thieves adore its little size.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈpeɪpɚ ænd θivz əˈdɔɹ ɪts ˈlɪɾəl saɪz/
dialogue.zh: 它就是張紙，小偷偏偏愛極它那小小一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, a drawer at home, hidden and boring.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ə ˈdɹaɚ æt hoʊm ˈhɪdən ænd ˈbɔɹɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好，放家裡的抽屜，藏起來，無聊到底。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boring is exactly where it should live.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɔɹɪŋ ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli wɛɹ ɪt ʃʊd lɪv/
dialogue.zh: 無聊，正是它最該住的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, can someone use my number, honestly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ kæn ˈsʌmˌwʌn juz maɪ ˈnʌmbɚ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 對了，說實話，別人能用我的號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only employers and taxes see that number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪmˈplɔɪɚz ænd ˈtæksəz sin ðæt ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 只有僱主的薪稅資料會用到這個號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So employers see it, strangers absolutely shouldn't.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪmˈplɔɪɚz sin ɪt ˈstɹeɪndʒɚz ˈæbsəˌlutli ʃʊdnt/
dialogue.zh: 所以僱主看得到，陌生人則絕對不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You've got it, quiz passed with flying colors.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊv ɡɑɾ ɪt kwɪz pæst wɪð ˈflaɪɪŋ ˈkʌlərz/
dialogue.zh: 你答對了，這一題滿分通過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, my family never praises, so thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ maɪ ˈfæməli ˈnɛvɚ ˈpɹeɪzəz soʊ θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我家人從不誇我，所以，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You earned it. Signature here, date, and press.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈɜɹnd ɪt ˈsɪɡnətʃɚ hɪɹ deɪt ænd pɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 你值得。這裡簽名、填日期，筆尖按實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done! And the receipt, um, two copies possible?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ænd ðə rɪˈsit ʌm tu ˈkɑpiz ˈpɑsəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 搞定！那個收據，嗯，可以給我兩份嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two copies, coming up, digital too if you'd like.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈkɑpiz ˈkʌmɪŋ ʌp ˈdɪdʒɪɾəl tu ɪf jud laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 兩份馬上來，數位版也可以給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Digital please, my folder is already fat enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɪdʒɪɾəl pliz maɪ ˈfoʊldɚ ɪz ɔlˈɹɛdi fæt ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩給我數位版，我的資料夾已經夠鼓了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sent. You'll get a status text in days.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnt jul ɡɛt ə ˈsteɪtəs tɛkst ɪn deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 傳了。幾天之內你會收到進度簡訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: To this phone, the one I just activated?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ðɪs foʊn ðə wʌn aɪ dʒʌst ˈæktəˌveɪɾəd/
dialogue.zh: 傳到這支手機？我剛辦好方案的那支？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, yes, that same new-plan phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ jɛs ðæt seɪm nu plæn foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，對，就是那支剛開通的新手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect timing then, my paperwork is finally moving.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ ðɛn maɪ ˈpeɪpɚˌwɛk ɪz ˈfaɪnəli ˈmuːvɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那時間真是剛好的，我的文件終於在往前跑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It flies when prepared people visit, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt flaɪz wɛn priˈpɛɹd ˈpipəl ˈvɪzɪt hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 準備周全的人來，流程就會飛起來，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll frame that quote, nobody warns me sooner.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl fɹeɪm ðæt kwoʊt ˈnoʊˌbɑdi wɔnz mi ˈsuːnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這一句話我要裱起來，沒人能更早提醒我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Monday job, two-week card, you're set, Kwame.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌnˌdeɪ dʒɑb tu wik kɑɹd jʊɹ sɛt kwaˈmeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 週一上班，兩週收卡，你全都備齊了，Kwame。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for turning fear into a form.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɚ ˈtɜɹnɪŋ fɪɹ ˈɪntə ə fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你把我的害怕變成了一張表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go shine Monday. Oh, your passport, safe return.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ ʃaɪn ˈmʌnˌdeɪ oʊ jɔɹ ˈpæspɔɹt seɪf rɪˈtɜɹn/
dialogue.zh: 週一去發光吧。噢，你的護照，完璧歸還。

script.youtube_title: 【人生第一張社保卡🪪】「卡片上沒照片也沒地址」社安署櫃檯申請實錄🗂️🏛️📮｜聽完就懂帶哪些文件｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜First Social Security Card
script.youtube_title_en: "No Photo, No Address" — Applying for My First Social Security Card
script.youtube_description:
「它上面沒照片、沒地址」——一張小小的紙卡，卻是第一份工作的入場券。這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在社會保障署的櫃檯前。

你會聽到：預約到場與開場寒暄；年齡、身份、合法停留三項證明的講法，護照、簽證、工作許可怎麼遞；名字有兩個版本時，卡片要跟哪一份文件一致；出生地要先寫城市還是國家；兩週寄達、收據先行、號碼只有僱主看得到，還有這張卡千萬別放錢包的忠告。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與十個詞以內的短句，反覆出現的是美國人辦業務時的真實語感：um、oh、so、right。聽完你就會用：I have an appointment、We need three proofs、When will the card actually arrive?、Never in a wallet。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱並打開小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"It lists no photo, no address" — one tiny paper card, and it is the ticket into your first job. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set right at the Social Security office counter.

You will hear: arriving for your appointment and small talk at the window; the three proofs of age, identity and work status, with passport, visa and permit changing hands; the middle-name dilemma when two documents disagree; which name the card must match; mailing times, the paper receipt that works meanwhile, and the real advice: never carry this card in your wallet.

Everything stays at A2 level, ten words or fewer per line, with the fillers Americans use at every service counter: um, oh, so, right. By the end you'll own lines like I have an appointment, We need three proofs and When will the card actually arrive?

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe and ring the bell for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
週一就要開始第一份工作，口袋裡卻還少一張小小的社保卡。證件到底要帶幾樣？名字在中間那一格該怎麼寫？卡片又該藏在家裡的哪個角落？

這一集帶大家走進社會保障署的櫃檯，從遞出護照與工作許可、核對三個名字的版本，一路聽到填表、收件據、問寄達時間，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🏛️ 開場句：Good morning. I have an appointment to apply today.
🪪 文件句：Passport, visa papers, all in this blue folder.
✍️ 名字句：My papers show Kwame Osei, no middle name.
🔒 保管句：Great question. Never in a wallet, ever.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、oh、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著 Kwame 坐一次櫃檯，下次自己遞文件時，表格上的每個格子都認得。

祝你的第一張卡，安安穩穩地到家。
